ui_bugs.issue: For positive running-balance rows the balance cell uses styles.glowNeutral which is only { color: '#FFFFFF' } and has NO textShadow. Per JARVIS Aura spec 'statement row debit/credit/balance cells are pure white ... with green/red text-shadow accordingly'. Verified via getComputedStyle on the '₹14,396 Dr' element: color=rgb(255,255,255) textShadow=none. Suggest replacing glowNeutral with styles.glowGreen for balForRow>=0 (or add textShadow to glowNeutral). Ref: /app/frontend/app/party/[id].tsx:294 and glowNeutral defined at line 521-523.

action_items: OPTIONAL (LOW): In /app/frontend/app/party/[id].tsx line ~294, the statement row Balance cell uses glowNeutral (no textShadow) for positive balances. To fully match JARVIS Aura spec ('balance cells pure white with green/red text-shadow accordingly'), either (a) use glowGreen for balForRow>=0 or (b) add a subtle green textShadow to glowNeutral so positive balances get the same passbook-style neon glow the closing-balance footer already has. Debit cell + Credit cell already carry glowGreen/glowRed correctly.

rca_of_issue: The one deviation stems from styles.glowNeutral being defined as { color: '#FFFFFF' } with no shadow (party/[id].tsx line 521-523). It was intended for balances of exactly zero, but line 294 also routes any positive running-balance through it. Fix: change conditional at line 294 to `balForRow > 0 ? styles.glowGreen : balForRow < 0 ? styles.glowRed : styles.glowNeutral` or add a soft green textShadow to glowNeutral.
